The selling price of 25 articles is equal to the cost price of 40 articles.

⇒ SP × 25 = CP × 40

⇒ (SP)/(CP) = 40over 25

⇒ Profit = (SP - CP)/(CP) ×100

⇒ P% = (40 - 25)/(25) ×100

⇒ P% = 15/25 × 100 = 60%

questions.question: A 360 m train crosses an electric pole in 12 seconds. Find the time (in seconds) taken by the train to cross a 150 m long bridge.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of train (D₁) = 360m 

Time (T₁) = 12s 

Length of bridge (D₂) = 150m 

**Formula used: **

Speed (S) = Distance/Time

**Calculation: **

Speed of train: 

⇒ S = D₁/T₁ = 360/12 m/s 

⇒ S = 30 m/s 

Time taken by the train to cross the bridge: 

⇒ S = D₂/T₂ or 

⇒ T₂ = D₂/S = 150/30 

⇒ T₂ = 5 s

Now to find the total time (T) taken by the 360m long train to cross the bridge: 

⇒ T₁ + T₂ = 12s +5s

⇒ T = 17s

**∴ The total time taken (T) by the train to cross a 150 m long bridge is 17s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• To find the total time we have to add the time taken by the train to cross 1 pole with the time taken by the train as 1 entity to cross the bridge because the train is itself 360m long and we have to calculate the time taken by the whole train to cross the bridge.

questions.question: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs. 6,000 in 4 years and to Rs. 6,750 in 7 years at the same rate percent p.a. of interest. The sum (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 3 years (7 − 4) = ₹(6,750 − 6,000) = ₹750

Interest for 1 year = 750 ÷ 3 = ₹250

Interest for 4 years = 250 × 4 = ₹1,000

Sum = Amount (at 4 years) − SI (for 4 years) = 6,000 − 1,000 = ₹5,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount after 4 years (A₁) = ₹6,000

Amount after 7 years (A₂) = ₹6,750

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e43408eae7591cab3630bbf3d2032f0eda8cd28a69b0e16b356bce187adf9d9e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Interest for (7 − 4) years = A₂ − A₁

⇒ Simple Interest for 3 years = ₹6,750 − ₹6,000 = ₹750

⇒ Simple Interest for 1 year = 750 ÷ 3 = ₹250

⇒ Simple Interest for 4 years = 250 × 4 = ₹1,000

⇒ Principal (P) = Amount after 4 years − SI for 4 years

⇒ Principal (P) = 6,000 − 1,000 = ₹5,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Property

In Simple Interest, the interest remains constant every year because it is always calculated on the original Principal (P).

General Amount Formula

The amount after T years can be written as A = P × (1 + RT ÷ 100), where R is the rate per annum.

Finding the Rate of Interest

Once the sum is known, the rate R can be calculated using R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T). Here, R = (1000 × 100) ÷ (5000 × 4) = 5% p.a.

questions.question: A dealer buys an article listed at Rs. 100 and get successive discounts of 10% and 20%. He spends 10% of the cost price on transportation. At what price should he sell the article to earn a profit of 15%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Listed Price of the article = Rs. 100

Successive discounts = 10% and 20%

Transportation cost = 10% of the cost price

Desired profit = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Successive Discount Formula: (1 - {discount1}) × (1 - {discount2}) × {Listed Price}

Cost Price including transportation = Cost Price + 10% of Cost Price

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Profit Percentage)

**Calculation:**

Applying the successive discounts:

Cost Price after 10% discount = 100 × (1 - 0.10)

⇒ 100 × 0.90 = 90

Cost Price after additional 20% discount = 90 × (1 - 0.20)

⇒ 90 × 0.80 = 72

Transportation cost = 10% of 72

⇒ 0.10 × 72 = 7.2

Total Cost Price = 72 + 7.2

⇒ 79.2

Desired Selling Price for 15% profit = 79.2 × (1 + 0.15)

⇒ 79.2 × 1.15

⇒ 91.08

**The price at which the dealer should sell the article to earn a profit of 15% is Rs. 91.08.**

questions.question: (tan 5x - tan 3x - tan 2x) = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any three angles where A = B + C, a standard trigonometric result states:

tan A − tan B − tan C = tan A × tan B × tan C

Here, we can see that 5x = 3x + 2x.

Applying the shortcut directly, we get:

tan 5x − tan 3x − tan 2x = tan 5x × tan 3x × tan 2x

**∴ The correct answer is tan 2x tan 3x tan 5x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The trigonometric expression: tan 5x − tan 3x − tan 2x

**Formula Used:**

tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B) ÷ (1 − tan A × tan B)

**Calculations:**

⇒ We know that 5x = 3x + 2x

⇒ Taking 'tan' on both sides, we get:

⇒ tan 5x = tan(3x + 2x)

⇒ tan 5x = (tan 3x + tan 2x) ÷ (1 − tan 3x × tan 2x)

⇒ Cross-multiplying the terms:

⇒ tan 5x × (1 − tan 3x × tan 2x) = tan 3x + tan 2x

⇒ tan 5x − tan 5x × tan 3x × tan 2x = tan 3x + tan 2x

⇒ Rearranging the equation to group the subtraction terms together:

⇒ tan 5x − tan 3x − tan 2x = tan 5x × tan 3x × tan 2x

**∴ The correct answer is tan 2x tan 3x tan 5x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent Sum Identity

The formula for the sum of two angles is tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B) ÷ (1 − tan A × tan B).

Tangent Difference Identity

The formula for the difference of two angles is tan(A − B) = (tan A − tan B) ÷ (1 + tan A × tan B).

Triple Angle Tangent Rule

If the sum of three angles A + B + C = 180° (or π), then tan A + tan B + tan C = tan A × tan B × tan C.

Double Angle Tangent Rule

For a single angle A, tan 2A = (2 × tan A) ÷ (1 − tan² A).

questions.question: Which natural number nearest to 9216, which is completely divisible by 88?
questions.solution:
__Calculation:__

If we divide 9216 by 88, we get

Remainder = 64, Quotient = 104

⇒ The nearest number to 9216 that is divisible by 88 is (88 - 64) = 24

Hence, the natural number nearest to 9216 which is completely divisible by 88 is 9240.

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a closed cuboidal box are 2.5 m, 2 m and 90 cm respectively. What will be the cost of the canvas required to completely cover this box, if the price of the canvas is ₹ 80 per square meter?

Length of the cuboidal box = 2.5 m

Breadth of the cuboidal box = 2 m

Height of the cuboidal box = 90 cm = 0.9 m

Cost of canvas per square meter = ₹ 80

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Total Cost = Surface Area × Cost per square meter

**Calculation:**

Surface Area of the box = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(2.5 × 2 + 2 × 0.9 + 0.9 × 2.5)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(5 + 1.8 + 2.25)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(9.05)

⇒ Surface Area = 18.1 m²

Total Cost = Surface Area × Cost per square meter

⇒ Total Cost = 18.1 × 80

⇒ Total Cost = 1,448

**The cost of the canvas required to completely cover the box is ₹ 1,448.**

questions.question: A, B and C started a business. A invested 33(1)/(3) % of the total capital, B invested 33(1)/(3) % of the remainingcapital and C, the remaining. If the total profit at the end of the year was ₹ 4,050, then find the amount by which the profit of C exceeds the profit of B.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total capital be 9 units.

A's investment = 1/3 of 9 = 3 units.

B's investment = 1/3 of the remaining 6 units = 2 units.

C's investment = Remaining units = 9 − 3 − 2 = 4 units.

Difference in C and B's profit = [(4 − 2) ÷ (3 + 2 + 4)] × 4050 = (2 ÷ 9) × 4050 = ₹900.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A invests 33¹⁄₃% of the total capital.

B invests 33¹⁄₃% of the remaining capital.

C invests the remaining capital.

Total profit at the end of the year = ₹4050.

**Formula Used:**

When the time period is identical for all partners, Profit Ratio = Capital Ratio.

 
 A: 3 parts
 
 
 B: 2 parts
 
 
 C: 4 parts

 
• 
 Total Capital / Profit = 9 parts = ₹4050
 
 
• 
 Difference (C − B) = 2 parts
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
• 
 
• 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total capital = 1 unit

⇒ A's capital = 33¹⁄₃% of 1 = 1/3

⇒ Remaining capital = 1 − 1/3 = 2/3

⇒ B's capital = 33¹⁄₃% of 2/3 = 1/3 × 2/3 = 2/9

⇒ C's capital = Remaining capital = 2/3 − 2/9 = 4/9

⇒ Profit Ratio A : B : C = 1/3 : 2/9 : 4/9 = 3 : 2 : 4

⇒ Total profit parts = 3 + 2 + 4 = 9 parts

⇒ 9 parts = ₹4050

⇒ 1 part = 4050 ÷ 9 = ₹450

⇒ Difference between C's profit and B's profit = 4 parts − 2 parts = 2 parts

⇒ Value of 2 parts = 2 × 450 = ₹900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Profit Ratio

When partners invest capital for different periods, the profit ratio is the product of capital and time: Profit Ratio = Capital × Time.

Sleeping vs Active Partner

An active partner usually receives a fixed salary or a specific percentage of the total profit for managing the business, and the remaining profit is distributed based on the capital invested.

Fraction Equivalents

Memorising percentage to fraction equivalents significantly accelerates exam calculations. For example: 33¹⁄₃% = 1/3, 16²⁄₃% = 1/6, and 66²⁄₃% = 2/3.

questions.question: If x³ + (1)/(x³) = 2, then find the value of x² - 2x.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If an equation is in the form a + 1/a = 2, then the value of a is always 1.

Here, replacing a with x³, we get x³ + 1/x³ = 2.

So, x³ = 1 ⇒ x = 1.

Substitute x = 1 in the required expression x² − 2x.

⇒ 1² − 2(1) = 1 − 2 = −1

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x³ + 1/x³ = 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x⁶ + 1) ÷ x³ = 2

⇒ x⁶ + 1 = 2x³

⇒ x⁶ − 2x³ + 1 = 0

Using the algebraic identity (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²:

⇒ (x³)² − 2(x³)(1) + (1)² = 0

⇒ (x³ − 1)² = 0

Taking square root on both sides:

⇒ x³ − 1 = 0

⇒ x³ = 1

⇒ x = 1

Now, we need to find the value of x² − 2x.

⇒ (1)² − 2(1)

⇒ 1 − 2 = −1

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Case 1

If x + 1/x = 2, then the only possible real value is x = 1.

Standard Algebraic Case 2

If x + 1/x = −2, then the only possible real value is x = −1.

Sum of Squares Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then the square values follow the pattern x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Sum of Cubes Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then the cube values follow the pattern x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

⇒ πr2 = 1386 cm2

⇒ r2 = (1386 × 7) / 22 = 441

⇒ r = 21 cm

⇒ Radius of Circle = 21 cm

⇒ Radius of Cylinder = 1/3 of radius of circle

⇒ Radius of Cylinder = (1/3) * 21 = 7 cm

⇒ Height of Cylinder = 2 × Radius of Cylinder 

⇒ Height of Cylinder = 2 × 7 = 14 cm

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = πR2h = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 14

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = 2156 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2156 cm³. Option 3) is correct.**

questions.question: The length of the portion of the straight line 5x + 12y = 60 intercepted between the axes is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Equation of a straight line: 5x + 12y = 60

**Concept used:**

The intercept form of a straight-line equation: (x)/(a) + (y)/(b) = 1

Where a and b are x and y intercepts respectively.

**Calculation:**

5x + 12y = 60

Dividing by 60 on both sides,

⇒ (5x)/(60)+(12y)/(60) =(60)/(60)

⇒ (x)/(12)+(y)/(5) =1

Here,

x-intercept = a = 12

y-intercept = b = 5

Now,

The length of the line segment intercepted between the axes is given by the distance between the intercepts:

Length = sqrt{a²+b²}

⇒ Length = sqrt{12²+5²} 

⇒ Length = sqrt{144+25}

⇒ Length = sqrt{169} = 13 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
